title: 12 Best Bookshops in Accra
description: Explore Accra's top bookshops, from cozy cafes to sprawling modern stores. Discover the best spots for African literature, academic texts, and popular picks in Ghana's vibrant capital.

places.name: BookNook.gh
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Browse their 'Ghanaian Authors' section for unique finds, and grab an Iced Latte from their cafe.

places.name: Silverbird Bookshop (Accra Mall)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Look for new releases in their fiction section or explore their extensive collection of children's storybooks.

places.name: Eppas Bookshop
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Dive into their history section for books on Ghanaian and West African history, or ask for recommendations on local authors.

places.name: The Literacy Cafe
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Pair a strong Ghanaian coffee with a new novel from an emerging African author, or pick up a beautifully illustrated children's book.

places.name: Kingdom Books & Stationery
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Explore their extensive academic sections for textbooks, or check out their range of inspirational and self-help books.

places.name: AfriReads Bookshop
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Ask for recommendations on contemporary Ghanaian novelists or explore their historical non-fiction section.

places.name: Vidya Bookstore
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Browse their comprehensive children's educational books or seek out textbooks for various subjects.

places.name: University of Ghana Bookshop (Legon Bookshop)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Look for publications from the University of Ghana Press, especially on African studies, sociology, or economics.

places.name: The Bookworm (Osu)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Explore their fiction section for well-known authors or ask for recommendations on timeless classics.

places.name: Challenge Bookshop
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Browse their wide variety of Bibles in different translations or explore their selection of Christian devotionals and biographies.

places.name: Prestige Books & Stationery
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Check their 'New Arrivals' for popular fiction, or browse their textbooks for students of all ages.

places.name: The Republic Bookstore
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Explore their specialized sections on politics, philosophy, or lesser-known African poets. Ask for their monthly staff picks.
